title: Civil War General-Purpose Computing | Cory Doctorow | Talks at Google
summary: Cory Doctorow's Talks at Google lecture on the coming civil war over general-purpose computing. He argues that locked-down devices, DRM, and surveillance threaten user control of computers.
why: It is HN's go-to reference whenever device lockdown, DRM, or restrictions on installing software come up, with commenters noting how prescient it was.

quote.text: I highly recommend reading up on what Cory has to say on DRM and the war on general purpose computing. It may change your mind.
